title: 1.14 Everyone to the Celebration!
unit_outcome: Understand and say short German sentences about people and what they are doing.
goal: Bring everyone to one family celebration by finding people, connecting the family, following actions, correcting false clues and answering who they are.
grammar_function: All German Unit 1 patterns, in a mission.
speaking_outcome: Answer who the family members are, out loud.

cards.audio_text: Ein Junge. Ein Mädchen. Ein Mann. Eine Frau.
cards.spanish_translation: A boy. A girl. A man. A woman.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 01/24: the learner follows one German clue and discovers how the game responds; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

audio_assets.text: The celebration is about to start and some guests are still missing. Listen to each German sentence, find the people, and discover what they are doing. At the end you will answer out loud to open the celebration. First we will practise together.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and tap the person.

cards.audio_text: Ein Mädchen. Ein Mann. Eine Frau. Ein Junge.
cards.spanish_translation: A girl. A man. A woman. A boy.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 02/24: three German clues bring the remaining people through the celebration gate; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen to one sentence at a time and tap the person.

cards.audio_text: Er ist ein Junge. Sie ist ein Mädchen. Er ist ein Mann. Sie ist eine Frau.
cards.spanish_translation: He is a boy. She is a girl. He is a man. She is a woman.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 03/24: pronouns identify all four arrivals without a draggable worksheet; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen to one sentence at a time and tap the person.

cards.audio_text: Der Junge ist ein Kind. Das Mädchen ist ein Kind. Der Mann ist erwachsen. Die Frau ist erwachsen. Der Junge und das Mädchen sind Kinder. Der Mann und die Frau sind erwachsen.
cards.spanish_translation: The boy is a child. The girl is a child. The man is an adult. The woman is an adult. The boy and the girl are children. The man and the woman are adults.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 04/24: the family map connects each person and then the two age groups; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

cards.audio_text: Er ist der Bruder. Sie ist die Schwester. Er ist der Vater. Sie ist die Mutter.
cards.spanish_translation: He is the brother. She is the sister. He is the father. She is the mother.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 06/24: the established children connect as brother and sister; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and tap the person.

cards.audio_text: Sie sind die Brüder. Sie sind die Schwestern. Sie sind die Eltern. Sie sind die Großeltern.
cards.spanish_translation: They are the brothers. They are the sisters. They are the parents. They are the grandparents.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 07/24: two distinct sibling groups connect through plural German clues; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and tap the group.

cards.audio_text: Er ist der Vater. Sie ist die Mutter. Sie sind die Eltern. Sie sind die Kinder.
cards.spanish_translation: He is the father. She is the mother. They are the parents. They are the children.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 08/24: father and mother connect before the parent pair is welcomed; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and tap the person or the couple.

cards.audio_text: Er ist der Großvater. Sie ist die Großmutter. Sie sind die Großeltern. Sie sind die Enkelkinder.
cards.spanish_translation: He is the grandfather. She is the grandmother. They are the grandparents. They are the grandchildren.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 09/24: the visible family map establishes both generations without age-only guessing; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and tap the person or the group.

cards.audio_text: Die Mutter isst. Der Großvater trinkt. Das Mädchen liest. Der Vater sitzt.
cards.spanish_translation: The mother is eating. The grandfather is drinking. The girl is reading. The father is sitting.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 10/24: the learner finds eating and drinking among several plausible actions; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and find who is doing the action.

cards.audio_text: Die Großmutter liest. Der Vater schreibt. Sie redet. Er trinkt.
cards.spanish_translation: The grandmother is reading. The father is writing. She is talking. He is drinking.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 11/24: reading and writing are distinguished by action and pronoun; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and find who is doing the action.

cards.audio_text: Sie rennt. Sie schwimmt. Der Junge sitzt. Sie redet.
cards.spanish_translation: She is running. She is swimming. The boy is sitting. She is talking.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 12/24: running and swimming are found inside one lively celebration scene; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and find who is doing the action.

cards.audio_text: Er sitzt. Sie schläft. Er liest. Sie arbeitet.
cards.spanish_translation: He is sitting. She is sleeping. He is reading. She is working.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 13/24: sitting and sleeping are found without using numbered or ordered boxes; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and find who is doing the action.

cards.audio_text: Die Babys spielen. Das Mädchen lernt. Die Eltern lesen. Sie redet.
cards.spanish_translation: The babies are playing. The girl is studying. The parents are reading. She is talking.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 14/24: playing and studying are found among visible decoy actions; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and find who is doing the action.

cards.audio_text: Die Großmutter arbeitet. Der Vater kocht. Die Schwestern reden. Der Großvater liest.
cards.spanish_translation: The grandmother is working. The father is cooking. The sisters are talking. The grandfather is reading.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 15/24: working, cooking, and talking complete the celebration preparations; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen and find who is doing the action.

cards.audio_text: Er isst nicht. Er trinkt. Er isst. Er liest. Er sitzt.
cards.spanish_translation: He is not eating. He is drinking. He is eating. He is reading. He is sitting.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 16/24: a complete negative German clue identifies the drinking man among active candidates; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen to the whole sentence and find who it describes.

cards.audio_text: Sie liest nicht. Sie schreibt. Sie liest. Sie redet. Sie kocht.
cards.spanish_translation: She is not reading. She is writing. She is reading. She is talking. She is cooking.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 17/24: a complete negative German clue identifies the writing woman; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen to the whole sentence and find who it describes.

cards.audio_text: Sie rennen nicht. Sie sitzen. Sie rennen. Sie reden. Sie spielen.
cards.spanish_translation: They are not running. They are sitting. They are running. They are talking. They are playing.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 18/24: a plural negative clue identifies the seated pair; the completed interaction advances the same family celebration adventure.

mission_game.instruction_es: Listen to the whole sentence and find the group.
